items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available
items.description: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
items.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
items.description:
Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

  • Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort.
  • Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, description, and sample questions — directly in the Power Apps maker portal. Search for understanding gaps and enrich missing context with a built-in glossary for domain-specific terms.
  • Governance and privacy built in — Enable or disable semantic signals at the org level, or at the individual signal-type or table level, giving makers and admins granular control to meet compliance and privacy requirements without sacrificing agent quality.

No manual schema mapping. No custom query logic. No disambiguation between what your data is called and what your business actually means.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
items.description:
Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high-level capabilities.

Intraday queue tracking

  • Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time.
  • Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand.
  • Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand.
  • Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations.
  • Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling breaks, or reallocating service representatives to maintain SLA performance.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

Intraday adherence tracking

  • Monitors service representative adherence to scheduled shift activities in real time.
  • Detects deviations such as late logins, extended breaks, or early logouts.
  • Autonomously mitigates deviations through actions such as break rescheduling, shift extensions, overtime activation, or flexible channel reassignment.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
items.description:
Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.

The experience highlights agreement, differences, and overall grading behavior.

Core capabilities

The core capabilities include:

  • Compare graders side-by-side.
  • Compare scores.
  • Review explanations from each grader.
  • Analyze grading consistency.

Results experience

Results include:

  • Comparative score view.
  • Pass / fail comparison.
  • Grader explanations.
  • Evidence supporting each evaluation.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description:
Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.
#copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
items.description: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
items.description:
Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage!

Powered by Engage MCP, this enhanced experience takes Copilot in Engage beyond catch-ups and summaries, helping users explore conversations more deeply, synthesize discussions, and uncover meaningful insights.

It's also more deeply connected across Microsoft 365. For example, you can ask Copilot to analyze feedback on a leader's post, identify key themes, and turn those insights into a reusable PowerPoint deck.

With Work IQ integration, Copilot also has a better understanding of you and your work context, connecting conversations in Engage to your broader work across Microsoft 365.

Engage MCP expands both the breadth and depth of Engage scenarios Copilot can support, making it more useful for understanding conversations and insights across your Engage network.

This update also brings Copilot in Engage closer to the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experience, with your Microsoft 365 agents now accessible directly within Copilot in Engage.

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on GitHub Copilot Harness
items.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the GitHub Copilot Harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
items.description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.

items.title: Work IQ: Human in the loop
items.description: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

items.title: Work IQ: Agent Policy Governance
items.description: Provide administrators with policy-based controls for governing agents and their capabilities at scale.

items.title: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts
items.description: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
items.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified device settings for voice and face recognition on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: It's easier for admins to enable the benefits of intelligent audio and video and Copilot for users in Teams Rooms through a new user interface and admin settings. These new settings, on the device and in the Pro Management portal, simplify configuration and remove the requirement to use PowerShell, offering improved visibility across rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 reporting availability for Microsoft platform agents
items.description: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license. Customers will be able to view reporting on their Microsoft platform-built agents in one consolidated picture, along with context on who built each agent and why.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
items.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
items.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize multiple resources with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description:
This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. Dispatchers can review and compare the proposed schedules with the current schedules before applying changes.

New capabilities include:

  • Optimize schedules for up to 5 resources directly from the schedule board.
  • Optimize schedules for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan.
  • Create custom goals and weight objectives.
  • Create custom optimization scopes to use with your optimization plans.

These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and will be automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent documentation.

Business Value:

Optimize multiple resources with the Scheduling Operations Agent (SOA). Schedule up to five resources directly from the schedule board or Copilot or perform ad-hoc optimizations for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan. This feature streamlines scheduling, improves efficiency, and supports better resource management.

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
items.description:
In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the (workflow) approval system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.

The APIs are read-only and allow querying for:

  • Workflow
  • Workflow and User mappings
  • Workflow, User, and Action history

We're also introducing a new permission set that allows a user to use approval APIs. This shouldn't be granted to standard users, but might be included in security-related permission sets.

Business Value:

This feature enhances transparency and control by enabling secure, read-only access to approval workflows and user actions. Businesses can leverage these APIs to build advanced auditing and compliance reports in tools like Power BI, ensuring stronger governance and accountability. Additionally, integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server opens opportunities for intelligent automation and analytics, driving efficiency and insight. By isolating permissions for API access, organizations maintain robust security while empowering authorized teams to innovate confidently.

Enabled for:

Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter the adherence tracker by planning group
items.description:
This feature provides the following capabilities:

  • The adherence tracker includes a planning group filter that supervisors can use to scope the view to a specific planning group.
  • The planning group filter works with the existing shift plan and service representative filters, so supervisors can combine filters to refine a single view.
  • The tracker displays representatives based on the planning groups associated with their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps the tracker aligned with the shift plan used to calculate adherence.
  • The tracker saves each supervisor’s filter selections across sessions and opens with their previous scope.
  • The tracker recalculates adherence percentages and out-of-adherence counts for the filtered scope, providing a planning group-level view of intraday adherence.
  • In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management > Adherence tracker.

Access and prerequisites

To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.

Business Value:

Supervising large contact centers is tough when you have to scan endless lists to find your team. Now, with planning group support, you can filter the adherence tracker to just the groups you manage. That means you spot issues faster and act right away, keeping service levels on track in real time instead of fixing problems after the fact. This feature scales for enterprise operations with hundreds of representatives and aligns with the same planning group structure you already use for forecasting, staffing, and scheduling. It saves time, reduces complexity, and helps you stay focused on what matters most: delivering consistent service.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter adherence historical analytics by planning group
items.description:
This feature provides the following capabilities:

  • The adherence historical analytics report includes a planning group filter that workforce managers can use to scope results to one or more planning groups.
  • The planning group filter works with the report’s existing filters, allowing managers to combine planning groups, date ranges, and other report parameters in a single view.
  • The report recalculates adherence metrics for the filtered scope, providing a group-level view of adherence performance instead of a contact center-wide aggregate.
  • The report associates representatives with planning groups through their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps historical reporting aligned with the shift plans used to calculate adherence.
  • Planning groups must be configured and have assigned representatives before the filter returns results.
  • In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management.

Access and prerequisites

  • To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.

Business Value:

Adherence only matters when it reflects how your work is organized. Until now, historical adherence reports didn’t account for planning groups, making it hard to see if performance dips came from a single under-supported queue or were spread across the operation.

With planning group support, you can focus your analysis on the groups that matter and compare adherence across them for the same time period. This gives you clearer insights and helps you make smarter staffing decisions.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions for representatives
items.description:
The plugin in Copilot Cowork is available out of the box for service representatives. They can use the Customer Service skills after the administrator enables the plugin for them in Cowork settings. The key capabilities are as follows:

  • Prioritizes and enriches cases: Surfaces highest-attention cases with suggested next actions.
  • Reviews for criticality and severity: Flags cases where severity mismatches actual urgency signals.
  • Briefs case at intake: One-screen customer, history, prior cases, and SLA snapshot.
  • Summarizes root cause and resolution: Proposes likely cause and ranked next-step resolutions.
  • Matches knowledge articles: Matches top articles, flags gaps, updates stale content.
  • Drafts replies: Generates template-based customer email replies for CSR review.
  • Handles escalations and handoffs: Detects triggers and assembles escalation packet for next owner.

Business Value:

The Customer Service plugin in Copilot Cowork helps service teams boost productivity at scale by offloading complex, multi-step case workflows. It ensures every action is grounded in the right Dynamics 365 environment and enriched with Microsoft 365 context, eliminating manual lookup.
The custom skills allow teams to tailor Cowork to their workflows, knowledge sources, and triage rules for more precise assistance. The built-in checkpoints provide human-in-the-loop governance, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and trust before any changes are committed.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Dynamics 365 Sales skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
items.description:
As an admin, you can control who can access Copilot Cowork in your organization. The Dynamics 365 Sales plugin is installed by default in Copilot Cowork and available to all users who have access to Cowork.

As a seller, you can use the sales skills in Copilot Cowork to:

  • Understand customer, opportunity, and pipeline context without manually gathering information from multiple systems.
  • Identify changes, risks, engagement patterns, and areas that require attention.
  • Prioritize work across customers, opportunities, leads, and pipeline activities.
  • Generate recommendations and next-best actions based on available business context.
  • Analyze business performance, pipeline health, and sales execution trends.
  • Support decision-making across individual, team, and organizational sales workflows.

Business Value:

If you spend the day moving between CRM, email, meetings, calendars, and collaboration tools, Dynamics 365 Sales skills bring that context together in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. By grounding Cowork in Dynamics 365 Sales data and Microsoft 365 signals, you get more relevant insights, recommendations, and actions in the flow of work. This helps you quickly understand customer relationships, opportunity health, pipeline changes, and next steps, so you spend less time gathering information and more time moving deals forward.

By combining customer, opportunity, account, lead, activity, and pipeline information with emails, meetings, calendars, and collaboration signals, Cowork can help users understand what has changed, identify what requires attention, and determine appropriate next actions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions across Dynamics 365 ERP
items.description:
The Copilot Cowork plugin for finance and operations apps enables users to move from business intent to insight to execution in a single experience. Copilot orchestrates work across ERP data, emails, documents, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and downstream business processes.

Key capabilities

  • Orchestrate workflows across ERP and Microsoft 365 data sources.
  • Analyze business data and generate contextual insights.

What this means for customers

The value is not just accessing ERP data through AI. Copilot Cowork enables agentic workflows where it can reason over business context, gather relevant information, evaluate options, and generate recommended actions.

This reduces manual coordination across systems, accelerates decision-making, and improves consistency in how business processes are executed.

Users can interact with ERP through business intent rather than navigating complex application layers and disconnected tools. This creates a more natural way to work, where users focus on outcomes instead of system interactions.

Business Value:

Enable users to move from business intent to insight to execution faster by orchestrating work across ERP data, emails, documents, and collaboration tools. Reduce manual coordination, accelerate decision-making, improve workflow consistency, and shift user time from information gathering to applying business judgment.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use pick-based assignment method for work items
items.description:
Use the No auto assignment method for queues in Copilot Service admin center when you want routed conversations to remain unassigned after they enter a queue. Instead of being assigned automatically, conversations stay in the queue until a service representative picks them up from their Inbox or a supervisor assigns them manually.

This assignment method supports a pick-based work distribution model, giving supervisors and service representatives greater control over how work is handled. Unlike the push-based model used by other out-of-the-box assignment methods, which automatically assign conversations based on representative availability and capacity, the no auto assignment method allows teams to review incoming work and decide who should handle it. This approach is well suited for organizations that prefer manual oversight, specialized work selection, or supervisor-managed assignments.

Business Value:

Improve operational control and consistency by enabling service representative-led work distribution. Conversations remain available in the queue until manually assigned by supervisors or picked by representatives, helping teams handle specialized, regulated, or sensitive interactions effectively.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Analyze adherence history to optimize workforce planning

Trend chart: Visualize adherence patterns for individual service representatives or the entire team over time.
Metrics dashboard: Track adherence percentage, total scheduled time, and time spent out of adherence.
Activity summary view: Access detailed activity records for each service representative, including precise durations for granular analysis.

You can find the Adherence History Report in the Copilot Service workspace by navigating to Workforce Management in the site map and selecting Adherence Historical Analytics.

Business Value:

Organizations can gain actionable insights into customer service representative adherence behavior over time. By analyzing trends and deviations, supervisors can make informed decisions to optimize workforce planning, reduce inefficiencies, and improve service-level compliance. Using these insights helps lead to better resource allocation, higher productivity, and an enhanced customer experience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Track real project progress from field execution
items.description:
This feature enhances Dynamics 365 Project Operations by extending its native work breakdown structure effort tracking to include approved time captured in Field Service when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled and time flows in at the project task level.

Approved Field Service time now contributes directly to task-level WBS execution metrics in Project Operations when time is captured against a project task. Task metrics such as effort completed, effort remaining, percent complete, estimate at completion, and schedule variance are calculated using approved field labor under the same native project rules used for time entered directly in Project Operations.

Because these calculations occur at the leaf task level, their impact rolls up automatically to summary tasks and the project root. Effort tracking views, reprojections, and project-level status indicators reflect real execution in the field, rather than inferred progress or manual reconciliation. Project managers can assess delivery health, forecast outcomes, and identify schedule risk using execution metrics grounded in approved field work.

This enhancement doesn't introduce new execution logic or formulas. It enables existing Project Operations WBS effort tracking behavior to include Field Service execution when time is captured against project tasks.

This feature is only available when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled.

Business Value:

When field technicians complete work tied to a project task, you see that progress reflected immediately in your project health metrics. Approved Field Service time flows directly into task-level work breakdown structure (WBS) tracking in Dynamics 365 Project Operations, so effort completed, percent complete, estimate at completion (EAC), and schedule variance stay accurate without manual reconciliation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Speed up processing with Known Senders in Payables Agent
items.description:
This feature introduces email review policy and a Known Senders list page to give accounts payable teams more control over which incoming emails require human approval before the Payables Agent processes them.

A new Email review field in the Payables Agent setup lets administrators choose when incoming emails require human approval. The following options are available:

  • Always: Every email requires approval, regardless of the sender.
  • Never: No emails require approval.
  • Only if untrusted (recommended): Only emails from senders who aren't on the list of known senders require review. This is the recommended setting for most organizations.

Administrators must explicitly select an option before they start to monitor the email inbox. To ensure that they make an active decision, a default isn't preselected for the field. Every known sender is subject to a setting that sets the review policy for the specific sender.

When you set the email review policy to Manage per sender, the agent evaluates incoming emails in the following order:

  • Invoice is uploaded and not received via email: No review required.
  • Email subfolder is configured: All emails in the monitored subfolder are treated as trusted. No review required.
  • Sender is on the Known Senders list: Action depends on the configured value (Ask, Approve, or Reject).
  • Internal sender (same organization, not on the list): No review required. Internal detection uses email authentication headers (planned to be available in 2026 wave 2, version 29.0.).

Administrators can maintain a list of known senders, each with a configured policy:

  • Ask: The email requires human approval.
  • Approve: The agent processes the invoice without review.
  • Reject: The sender is blocked and the attachment isn't processed.

To build the list organically, after you review an email and want to continue, the sender is added automatically to the list of known senders, provided that the Manage per sender policy is active. Security telemetry is logged for each auto-addition.

This feature is available from the August minor release of 2026 release wave 1.

Business Value:

Payables Agent processes vendor invoices received by email, but today every incoming email requires supervisor approval before the agent can act on it, unless email review is disabled entirely. This creates friction for accounts payable teams who repeatedly receive invoices from the same vendors. They must manually approve each email, even from senders they already trust. The Known Senders feature lets businesses define which senders the agent can process automatically, reducing manual intervention while maintaining control over unknown or unverified sources. With this capability, organizations can safely default email review to off, moving closer to fully autonomous invoice processing.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Classify emails by category and subcategory with Case Management Agent
items.description:
With email classification, administrators can define a custom taxonomy of categories and subcategories to automatically classify inbound emails in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. AI analyzes the email subject and body, then stores the assigned category or subcategory on the email activity record. Case Management Agent, automatic record creation rules, Power Automate flows, reporting, and other downstream processes can use this value to determine how to handle the email.

Administrators can enable email classification and define category and subcategory names and descriptions. They can also set conditions that determine which emails are classified, such as specific mailboxes, sender domains, languages, and so forth. When the feature is enabled, the system qualifies inbound emails and automatically classifies them by using the Case Management Agent flow. Administrators can also manually update an assigned category or subcategory, or disable classification to stop processing new emails.

Business Value:

Email classification gives you control over how incoming emails are managed before any action is taken. It automatically sorts messages so you can ignore irrelevant ones, let the Case Management Agent handle routine issues, and focus on those that truly need human attention. This reduces clutter from non-support emails like thank-you notes, newsletters, and spam, allowing both AI and your team to concentrate on what matters most. The result is time saved, lower processing costs, and the ability to scale automated email handling confidently without adding operational risk.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Detect intraday volume spikes with workforce alerts
items.description:
Supervisors can create volume spike alerts that compare real-time conversation volume with the forecast linked to a shift plan. When volume remains above forecast for the configured number of intervals, selected recipients receive an in-app notification.

The capability includes the following features:

  • Administrators can enable workforce alerts in Copilot Service admin center by going to Workforce management > Intraday management > Workforce alerts.
  • Supervisors can create and manage alerts from Workforce alerts in the Copilot Service workspace site map.
  • Each alert references a shift plan and monitors the queues associated with its linked capacity plan.
  • Supervisors can specify the percentage by which actual volume must exceed forecast volume.
  • Supervisors can specify the number of consecutive intervals during which the deviation must continue before an alert is raised. The forecast determines whether an interval is 15, 30, or 60 minutes.
  • Supervisors can set an expiration date to limit an alert to a campaign, season, or known event.
  • Supervisors can select one or more notification recipients for each alert.
  • Active alerts are evaluated on a recurring schedule. Notifications are sent when the configured threshold and duration are met.
  • Recipients can select a notification to open the alert details. The details include the queue and alert name, detection time, current and forecast volumes, spike percentage, and an interval-by-interval breakdown.

Access and prerequisites

  • An administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from Power Platform admin center.
  • Forecasting and scheduling must be configured.
  • The selected shift plan must have a linked capacity plan and forecast.
  • Real-time conversation data must be available for the monitored queues.

Business Value:

Contact centers plan staffing based on forecasted demand, but actual demand can change quickly. When conversation volume rises significantly above forecast, queues can grow and service levels can decline before supervisors have time to respond.

Workforce alerts help supervisors identify unusual intraday volume changes without continuously monitoring a dashboard. Supervisors define the deviation and duration that represent a volume spike and select who should be notified when those conditions are met.

The notification provides information about the spike, including how far actual volume is above forecast and whether the deviation is continuing. Supervisors can use this information to decide whether to shift capacity, offer overtime, or defer offline work while these actions can still help protect the customer experience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
items.description:
This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved:

  • Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be transferred to another available queue, ensuring a smooth end-of-day experience without manual intervention.

  • No service representatives are signed in: The system evaluates real-time representative availability. If all representatives assigned to a queue are signed out, it immediately triggers the configured fallback action instead of waiting for in-queue overflow timers. This is especially valuable in scenarios such as mass logout events, unexpected breaks, or holidays not captured in operating hours.

Administrators configure both scenarios using natural language prompts in conversation orchestration, enabling fine-grained control over queue behavior. This ensures customers are always routed to the best possible outcome, even when direct support is unavailable.

Business Value:

This capability ensures customers are never left waiting when representatives aren't available. Whether a queue transitions to be out-of-operating hours or all support representatives are logged out, the system proactively routes conversations to configured fallback options such as voicemail, callback, or alternative queues.

Organizations benefit from reduced wait times and lower abandonment, improved customer satisfaction during peak load or unexpected staffing gaps, and a more predictable service experience regardless of representative availability. At the same time, this eliminates the need for manual queue draining or extended shifts, helping protect service representative wellbeing while maintaining consistent service levels.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Monitor intraday performance against the forecast
items.description:
The intraday performance report provides supervisors with an interval-level view of performance against the forecast. In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management to access the report.

  • Compare forecast and actual contact volume and average handle time. Variances appear as values and percentages, making outliers easier to identify.
  • Compare forecast, required, and scheduled staffing levels to identify understaffed and overstaffed intervals.
  • Review service level, occupancy, and schedule adherence alongside volume and staffing data in a single report.
  • View data in 15-, 30-, or 60-minute intervals to match how your organization manages intraday performance.
  • Filter the report by planning group and shift plan to focus on the areas you manage.

Access and prerequisites

To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.

Business Value:

Contact center forecasts and schedules are built days or weeks in advance, but demand rarely arrives exactly as planned. When volume spikes, handle times run long, or agents are absent, supervisors often don't see the gap until service levels have already slipped and the interval is gone.

The intraday performance report closes that gap by showing plan versus actual as the day unfolds. Supervisors can see which intervals are under- or over-staffed and act while there's still time by moving agents between queues, adjusting break and training schedules, or opening overtime only where it's genuinely needed. That protects service level and abandonment targets on the days that matter most, and it curbs the two costs that quietly compound in every contact center: paying for idle capacity in over-forecasted intervals and paying premium rates to recover from under-forecasted ones.
